integrity: Proof by disjoint local orientation counting and Newton inequalities, tested against directly constructed finite graphs. No independent validation or claim of universal computer certification.
scientific_limitations: General exact polynomial and strict log-concavity for all clique bouquets; full heterogeneous real-rootedness region proved only for three blocks. Earlier unindexed work may affect historical priority; independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: Sharp sink-polynomial root transitions in clique bouquets
